selected_change: Construct SQLNULL by name instead of parsing its quoted type declaration. No cache or ownership change.
combined_extra_patch:
--- a/duckdb-simple/src/Database/DuckDB/Simple/ToField.hs
+++ b/duckdb-simple/src/Database/DuckDB/Simple/ToField.hs
@@ -1520,9 +1520,15 @@
                 bracket (output (c_duckdb_v2_value_get_logical_type value)) destroyLogicalType \logical ->
                   (/= 0) <$> output (c_duckdb_v2_logical_type_is_equal logical plainNull)
               pure (if untyped then kept else value : kept)
-  present <-
-    bracket (makeType (LogicalTypeScalar LogicalTypeIdSQLNull)) destroyLogicalType \plainNull ->
-      reverse <$> foldM (keep plainNull) [] values
+      -- Construct the comparison type only if a NULL needs it.
+      untilNull kept [] = pure (reverse kept)
+      untilNull kept (value : rest) =
+        output (c_duckdb_v2_value_is_null value) >>= \flag ->
+          if flag == 0
+            then untilNull (value : kept) rest
+            else bracket (makeType (LogicalTypeScalar LogicalTypeIdSQLNull)) destroyLogicalType \plainNull ->
+              reverse <$> foldM (keep plainNull) kept (value : rest)
+  present <- untilNull [] values
   case present of
     value : rest -> bracket (output (c_duckdb_v2_value_get_logical_type value)) destroyLogicalType \logical -> do
       -- See Note [Type aliases] in "Database.DuckDB.Simple.LogicalRep".

measurement.arm_order: Pairs 1/3: first arm then second arm; pairs 2/4: second arm then first arm. First/second arms: baseline/combined, combined/constructor, and baseline/constructor. Each arm runs NULL fixture then dynamic fixture.
measurement.allocation_scope: GHC allocated_bytes only; excludes native heap allocation. Major GC before and after each sample. Native RSS is checked separately by the leak suite.
measurement.latency_scope: Complete query, including parameter conversion, SQL execution and result validation. Both NULL counts or dynamic type, length, payload order and sum are checked.
measurement.comparison_boundary: Final CSV is a direct baseline-versus-constructor comparison. The two earlier comparisons are retained separately as rejected-candidate evidence.

constructor_control.result: Passed: named and quoted NULL are equal and unaliased SQLNULL for connection and instance factories.

scenarios.default_schema: CREATE TYPE "NULL" AS VARCHAR was rejected because NULL already exists; constructors still checked.
scenarios.search_path: CREATE SCHEMA custom; CREATE TYPE custom."NULL" AS VARCHAR; SET search_path=custom,main; passed.
scenarios.system_registration: R.registerCustomType "NULL" with VARCHAR base succeeded; constructors remained unaliased SQLNULL.

constructor_control.rejected_candidate: Unquoted from_text("NULL") succeeds on connection factories but fails to parse on instance factories.

validation.exact_final: cabal build all -j1 --disable-documentation; cabal test all -j1 --disable-documentation --test-show-details=direct. Passed: 835 high-level, 171 FFI tests, nonthreaded and default leak suite. DUCKDB_TEST_VERSION=2.0.0.
validation.stress_boundary: leak all 100 passed on combined arm, which has the same NULL constructor. Final ToField.hs reverts to the previously tested baseline. all100 was not repeated for the final one-line arm.
validation.optional_components: DataFrame, extension flag suites and Valgrind were not rerun for this isolated patch.
validation.formatting: fourmolu and git diff --check passed; no Cabal files changed.
validation.retained_driver_smoke: All three retained drivers compiled and ran successfully against the exact final source. The stricter constructor control requires successful search-path and system-registration setups.
validation.evidence_validation: Independently verified raw row counts, unique sample identities, CSV/source/driver hashes, all ten final group medians, and sample denominators.

rejected_change: Lazy plain-NULL sentinel loop: small and inconsistent latency differences, only about 1-4 KiB/query allocation difference. Retain the one-line constructor change.

The retained copies were compiled and smoke-tested separately; their smoke timings are not included in the CSV.
reproduction: Use separate worktrees at baseline_commit and at the selected one-line change, with the same pinned nix-shell dev/nix/shell.nix and matching generated binding checksums. Build serially under heavy-management/bin/capped.
Run GHC_ENVIRONMENT=- cabal build all -j1 --disable-documentation for each arm.

Compile each retained driver from its worktree with env -u GHC_ENVIRONMENT cabal exec -- ghc -O2 -threaded -rtsopts -package duckdb-simple DRIVER -odir UNIQUE_OBJECT_DIR -hidir UNIQUE_OBJECT_DIR -o UNIQUE_BINARY. Add -package duckdb-ffi for the constructor control. Keep each binary and object directory separate.

Inside the same pinned shell, run the saved binaries with +RTS -T -N1 -RTS. Alternate arm order across four pairs. No builds or other heavy jobs may overlap timing. Preserve each stdout CSV and combine it with comparison, arm, pair and sample labels.
To reproduce the discarded combined arm, apply combined_extra_patch to the selected constructor-only source. It changes only ToField.hs; verify the recorded source hash.
